title: GatewayBench: Unified Capability and Security Evaluation Platform for MCP Gateways

paragraphs.en: AI agents have increasingly interacted with external environments by invoking tools, with Model Context Protocol (MCP) emerging as a standard interface for connecting agents to heterogeneous tools and services. As organizations deploy agents at scale, MCP gateways have become a critical middleware layer for aggregating, governing, and shaping the tool surface exposed to agents. However, gateway design can substantially affect agent behavior: as the number of available tools grows, agents may struggle with tool discovery and selection, leading to degraded task performance, increased computational overhead, and potentially greater exposure to malicious tools. Despite the growing importance of MCP gateways in agentic systems, no prior work has systematically studied how gateway design affects agent capability, efficiency, and security. To address this gap, we introduce GatewayBench , the first unified evaluation framework and benchmark for MCP gateways. We characterize gateway architectures into two major paradigms: flattened gateways , which expose the complete set of available tools to the agent upfront, and hierarchical gateways , which provide tool-discovery meta-tools that allow agents to selectively retrieve relevant tools on demand. GatewayBench comprises 524 tasks across six domains, together with a pool of 11,118 real-world tools from 251 authentic MCP servers. To emulate large-scale deployments, we systematically inject task-irrelevant tools sampled from this pool into each agent environment, enabling controlled evaluation as the accessible tool surface scales. Each task is evaluated using verifiable judges that inspect the resulting environment state quantitatively. Based on GatewayBench , we conduct extensive experiments across seven widely deployed MCP gateways and diverse agent configurations, covering both benign and adversarial tasks. Our results reveal substantial differences across gateway designs in task completion, tool-use efficiency, and resilience to attacks, and further demonstrate that these effects interact strongly with the underlying model and agent harness. These findings highlight the MCP gateway as a consequential yet underexplored component of the agentic AI stack. By enabling controlled evaluation of gateway architectures under realistic tool ecosystems, GatewayBench provides both practical guidance for MCP gateway design and a rigorous testbed for developing more capable, efficient, and secure agentic systems.

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents are rapidly evolving from single-step tool calling into autonomous systems capable of executing complex, multi-step workflows ( Gaurav et al., 2025 ; Qin et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2023 ) . In practice, the agent’s behavior is shaped not only by the underlying model but also by its surrounding harness : the engineering infrastructure that manages the full lifecycle of context, including system prompts, tool execution, memory management, verification, and failure recovery ( Anthropic, 2025 ; OpenAI, 2026 ; LangChain, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体正迅速从单步工具调用演变为能够执行复杂多步工作流的自主系统（Gaurav 等，2025；Qin 等，2023；Wu 等，2023）。 在实践中，智能体的行为不仅受底层模型的影响，也受其周围框架的塑造：即管理上下文完整生命周期的工程基础设施，包括系统提示、工具执行、记忆管理、验证和故障恢复（Anthropic，2025；OpenAI，2026；LangChain，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Within the harness, tool execution is the component that determines how an agent accesses external environments and services. The Model Context Protocol (MCP) ( Anthropic, 2024 ) has emerged as a widely adopted standard for exposing tools to agents. MCP servers can run remotely and expose their capabilities over standardized transport protocol, enabling agents to connect to tool providers across the network without managing local dependencies or execution environments ( Hou et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在约束框架内，工具执行是决定智能体如何访问外部环境和服务的组件。 模型上下文协议（MCP）（Anthropic，2024）已成为向智能体暴露工具的广泛采用标准。 MCP 服务器可以远程运行，并通过标准化传输协议暴露其能力，使智能体能够连接到网络中的工具提供商，而无需管理本地依赖项或执行环境（Hou 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: In a production LLM agent deployment, however, an organization typically operates multiple agents serving different users and business functions, each connecting to a distinct set of MCP servers. Such distributed management approach, exemplified by personal agents like OpenClaw ( OpenClaw, 2026 ) , quickly becomes unsustainable at enterprise scale: agents must independently track server endpoints, manage separate credentials, and absorb any upstream change to a server’s tool set or configuration. To resolve this scalability and management challenge, the MCP gateway has emerged as a middleware layer within the agent harness, acting as the unified endpoint between the reasoning model and the external services ( AWS, 2026 ; Arcade, 2026 ) . Existing MCP gateways broadly fall into two types: the flattened gateways which expose the full set of available tools as a single list, and the hierarchical gateways which instead provide tool-discovery meta-tools that let the agent selectively retrieve tools on demand (Figure 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 然而，在生产环境的 LLM 智能体部署中，一个组织通常会运行多个为不同用户和业务功能服务的智能体，每个智能体都会连接到一组独立的 MCP 服务器。 这种分布式管理方式（以 OpenClaw（OpenClaw, 2026）等个人智能体为例）在企业规模下很快就会变得难以维持：智能体必须独立跟踪服务器端点、管理各自的凭证，并吸收服务器工具集或配置的任何上游变更。 为了解决这一可扩展性和管理挑战，MCP 网关已成为智能体框架内的一层中间件，充当推理模型与外部服务（AWS, 2026；Arcade, 2026）之间的统一端点。 现有的 MCP 网关大致分为两类：扁平化网关将所有可用工具以单一列表形式暴露出来，而分层网关则提供工具发现元工具，使智能体能够按需选择性地获取工具（图 2）。

paragraphs.en: To answer these questions, we introduce GatewayBench (Figure 1 ), a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate MCP gateways across diverse task domains, different underlying LLM agent, scalable tool-set configurations, and adversarial threat models. GatewayBench is built upon two existing high-quality agent evaluation datasets: DecodingTrust-Agent Platform ( DTap ) ( Chen et al., 2026 ) and MCP-Universe ( Luo et al., 2025 ) . Our benchmark extends these foundational datasets with a large-scale, carefully curated pool of noisy, task-irrelevant tools. These noisy tools can be dynamically injected into the agent’s environment to simulate realistic scenarios where agents must reason over a large and potentially distracting tool surface, thereby enabling controlled measurement of how gateway architectures influence tool selection robustness and task completion under varying numbers of noisy tools and adversarial conditions.

paragraphs.en: Across these environments, we then conduct intensive experiments spanning 7 widely-deployed gateway implementations, including 6 open-source gateways and 1 closed-source gateway. paragraphs.en: Asymmetric Sensitivity to Tool-Set Scaling. Flattened gateways exhibit a subtle degradation in task success as more noisy tools are injected, whereas hierarchical gateways remain largely invariant to the number of injected tools. This divergence is modulated by the agent’s underlying reasoning capability. For weaker models, this degradation is insufficient to overcome the overall performance advantage of flattened gateways. For stronger models, however, the hierarchical gateways overtake the flattened ones once many noisy tools are injected.
paragraphs.zh: 对工具集扩展的非对称敏感性。 随着更多噪声工具的引入，扁平化网关的任务成功率会出现轻微下降，而分层网关则基本不受所引入工具数量的影响。 这种差异受到智能体底层推理能力的调节。 对于较弱的模型而言，这种性能下降不足以抵消扁平化网关在整体性能上的优势。 然而，对于较强的模型，一旦引入大量噪声工具，分层网关的性能便会超越扁平化网关。

paragraphs.en: In summary, our main contributions are as follows:

paragraphs.en: We introduce GatewayBench , the first systematic benchmark for evaluating MCP gateways as a core component of the agent harness. GatewayBench comprises 524 tasks spanning 6 domains, together with a curated pool of over 11,000 real-world noisy tools from 251 MCP servers, enabling controlled measurement of how gateway design choices shape agent capability, efficiency, and security at scale.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 GatewayBench，这是首个用于评估 MCP 网关作为智能体框架核心组件的系统性基准测试。 GatewayBench 包含覆盖 6 个领域的 524 项任务，以及从 251 个 MCP 服务器中精心收集的超过 11,000 个真实世界的噪声工具库，从而能够受控地测量网关设计选择如何影响智能体在大规模环境下的能力、效率和安全性。

paragraphs.en: We formalize a taxonomy of MCP gateway designs (flattened vs. hierarchical), and conduct a comprehensive empirical study of 7 widely deployed gateway implementations under both benign tasks and red-teaming attacks with up to 1,500 injected noisy tools.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对 MCP 网关设计（扁平化与分层式）的分类体系进行了形式化定义，并对 7 种广泛部署的网关实现，在良性任务以及注入多达 1,500 个噪声工具的“红队”攻击场景下，开展了全面的实证研究。

paragraphs.en: Our findings offer practical guidance for MCP gateway selection and agent deployment: hierarchical gateways provide superior scalability and adversarial robustness as the tool set grows under capable models, whereas flattened gateways are simpler and more efficient for small tool sets. We also emphasize the importance of jointly optimizing the MCP gateway with the rest of the agent harness and the underlying model as an integrated system.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究结果为 MCP 网关选择和智能体部署提供了实用指导：随着工具集在能力强大的模型下不断扩展，分层网关能提供更强的可扩展性和对抗性鲁棒性；而扁平化网关则在小规模工具集中更简单、更高效。 我们还强调，将 MCP 网关与智能体框架的其他部分以及底层模型作为一个集成系统，进行联合优化至关重要。

paragraphs.en: As LLM agents connect to a growing number of MCP servers ( Hou et al., 2026 ; Stein, 2026 ) , MCP gateways have emerged as a middleware layer that aggregates and governs the tools exposed to an agent ( Errico et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 随着 LLM 智能体连接到数量不断增长的 MCP 服务器（Hou 等人，2026；Stein，2026），MCP 网关已成为一种中间件层，用于聚合和管理向智能体暴露的工具（Errico 等人，2025）。

paragraphs.en: Mainstream MCP gateways adopt two dominant designs for managing and exposing tools. The most direct design, which we refer to as flattened gateways, exposes the full tool list to the agent in every interaction, which is the default option for many agent hanress and gateways ( OpenClaw, 2026 ; BerriAI, 2023 ) . Another type of approach, which we refer to as hierarchical gateways, exposes only a few tool-discovery meta-tools, upon which the agent discovers and dynamically loads the tools it needs on demand. A line of research work explores such scalable tool-access methods, including RAG-MCP ( Gan and Sun, 2025 ) , MCP-Zero ( Fei et al., 2025 ) , ScaleMCP ( Lumer et al., 2025 ) , and Dynamic ReAct ( Gaurav et al., 2025 ) . Relative to the flattened baseline, these methods reduce the number of tools exposed per query while aiming to preserve selection accuracy as the tool set scales.
paragraphs.zh: 主流 MCP 网关在管理和暴露工具方面采用了两种主要设计。 最直接的设计，我们称之为扁平化网关，会在每次交互中向智能体暴露完整的工具列表，这也是许多智能体处理程序和网关的默认选项（OpenClaw, 2026；BerriAI, 2023）。 另一种方法，我们称之为分层网关，仅暴露少数用于发现工具的元工具，智能体基于这些元工具按需发现并动态加载所需工具。 一系列研究探索了此类可扩展的工具访问方法，包括 RAG-MCP（Gan and Sun, 2025）、MCP-Zero（Fei et al., 2025）、ScaleMCP（Lumer et al., 2025）和 Dynamic ReAct（Gaurav et al., 2025）。 与扁平化基线方法相比，这些方法减少了每次查询所暴露的工具数量，同时力求在工具集规模扩大时保持选择准确性。

paragraphs.en: A growing body of benchmarks evaluates the tool-use competency of LLM agents in the MCP ecosystem. MCP-Universe ( Luo et al., 2025 ) , LiveMCPBench ( Mo et al., 2025 ) , and MCPMark ( Wu et al., 2026 ) assess task success and tool orchestration over large, realistic MCP tool collections, while MCP-Atlas ( Bandi et al., 2026 ) , MCP-Bench ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , and MCPAgentBench ( Liu et al., 2026 ) additionally mix task-relevant tools with plausible distractors to probe retrieval under a crowded tool set. These benchmarks target agent capability under a fixed tool-exposure scheme. In contrast, Xu et al. (2026) shows that tool architecture alone can substantially affect coding-agent consistency and efficiency under similar tool capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的基准测试正在评估 MCP 生态系统中 LLM 智能体的工具使用能力。 MCP-Universe（Luo 等人，2025）、LiveMCPBench（Mo 等人，2025）和 MCPMark（Wu 等人，2026）通过大规模、贴近实际的 MCP 工具集来评估任务成功率和工具协同能力；而 MCP-Atlas（Bandi 等人，2026）、MCP-Bench（Wang 等人，2025）和 MCPAgentBench（Liu 等人，2026）则进一步将任务相关工具与合理的干扰项混合，以测试在工具集繁杂情况下的检索能力。 这些基准测试针对的是在固定工具暴露方案下智能体的能力。相比之下，Xu 等人 （2026）的研究表明，在工具能力相似的情况下，仅工具架构本身就可能显著影响编码智能体的一致性和效率。

paragraphs.en: Beyond task competency, a complementary direction studies the safety and robustness of tool-use agents under adversarial tools or outputs. Benchmarks such as AgentDojo ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) , InjecAgent ( Zhan et al., 2024 ) , and Agent Security Bench ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) , together with red-teaming platforms like DTap ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , evaluate agents against prompt injection and related attacks over untrusted tools and environments. Closer to our work, MCPTox ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , MSB ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) and MCP-SafetyBench ( Zong et al., 2025 ) target MCP-based agents specifically, measuring robustness to tool poisoning and injection.

sents.en: Closer to our work, MCPTox ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , MSB ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) and MCP-SafetyBench ( Zong et al., 2025 ) target MCP-based agents specifically, measuring robustness to tool poisoning and injection.

paragraphs.en: Within the agent harness, the MCP gateway serves as the unified endpoint between the agent and upstream MCP servers, aggregating, governing, and shaping the tool surface exposed to the reasoning model. This centrality makes it both a bottleneck and an accelerator: how it exposes tools directly determines token consumption, the attack surface reachable by injected tools, and the model’s burden in tool selection. In this work, we focus exclusively on MCP gateways that shape the tool surface. Infrastructure orchestration systems (e.g., Microsoft MCP Gateway ( Microsoft, 2025 ) ) and protocol-translation utilities (e.g., Unla ( AmoyLab, 2025 ) ) fall outside our scope.
paragraphs.zh: 在智能体框架中，MCP 网关充当智能体与上游 MCP 服务器之间的统一端点，负责聚合、管理和塑造提供给推理模型的工具接口。 这种核心地位使其既是瓶颈，也是加速器：其工具暴露方式直接决定了令牌消耗量、注入工具可触及的攻击面，以及模型在工具选择方面所承受的压力。 本研究仅关注那些能够塑造工具接口的 MCP 网关。 基础设施编排系统（例如，Microsoft MCP Gateway ( Microsoft, 2025 )）和协议转换工具（例如，Unla ( AmoyLab, 2025 )）不在我们的研究范围内。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 2 , existing MCP gateway designs can be broadly categorized into two types. The first type of gateway, which we call flattened gateways , aggregates all available tools from every connected MCP server into a single flat list and exposes them directly to the agent in each interaction. The agent must first read the full tool list before starting the task. Although this approach maximizes transparency and simplifies implementation, it also raises concerns about extra token consumption caused by task-irrelevant tools.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 2 所示，现有的 MCP 网关设计大致可分为两类。 第一类网关我们称之为扁平化网关，它将所有已连接 MCP 服务器上的可用工具汇总到一个单一的扁平列表中，并在每次交互中直接将其提供给智能体。 智能体在开始任务之前，必须首先读取完整的工具列表。 尽管这种方法最大限度地提高了透明度并简化了实现，但也引发了对因任务无关工具而导致的额外令牌消耗问题的担忧。

paragraphs.en: The second type of gateway, which we call hierarchical gateways , preserves the MCP server–tool hierarchy and instead exposes a set of special tool discovery meta-tools to the agent. These meta-tools can take diverse forms in practice. Instead of receiving the full tool list upfront, the agent must actively query the meta-tools to selectively discover and retrieve tools bound to specific servers. paragraphs.zh: 第二种网关，我们称之为分层网关，保留了 MCP 服务器与工具之间的层级关系，转而向智能体提供一组特殊的工具发现元工具。 这些元工具在实践中可以呈现多种不同的形式。 智能体不会一开始就收到完整的工具列表，而是必须主动查询这些元工具，以选择性地发现和获取与特定服务器绑定的工具。 这种结构天然地限制了对任务无关工具的暴露，但同时也将工具发现的负担转移到了智能体的推理循环中。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 provides the qualitative comparison of the seven MCP gateway implementations evaluated in this work: AgentCore ( AWS, 2025 ) , Agentgateway ( Agent Gateway, 2025 ) , LiteLLM ( BerriAI, 2023 ) , Lunar MCPX ( Lunar.dev, 2025 ) , Enkrypt Secure MCP Gateway ( Enkrypt AI, 2025 ) , Strata ( Klavis AI, 2025 ) , Bifrost ( Maxim, 2025 ) . Flattened gateways always prefix each tool name with its server identifier to resolve name collisions between servers. Some gateways like LiteLLM and Lunar MCPX sort these tools by server name. paragraphs.en: GatewayBench is a comprehensive benchmark designed to systematically evaluate the performance, efficiency, and security resilience of MCP gateway architectures across diverse real-world workflows, noisy tool environments, and adversarial scenarios. In total, GatewayBench comprises a task dataset spanning 6 domains and containing 524 distinct tasks , which include 450 benign and adversarial tasks from DTap and 74 complex execution tasks from MCP-Universe. To rigorously evaluate gateway capabilities under realistic deployment conditions, we further construct a comprehensive real-world tool pool consisting of 11,118 unique tools from 251 authentic MCP servers . Figure 3 provides a high-level overview of the benchmark dataset.
paragraphs.zh: GatewayBench 是一项综合性基准测试，旨在系统性地评估 MCP 网关架构在各种真实工作流程、存在噪声的工具环境以及对抗性场景中的性能、效率和安全性韧性。 总体而言，GatewayBench 包含一个涵盖 6 个领域、共 524 项不同任务的作业数据集，其中包括来自 DTap 的 450 项良性及对抗性任务，以及来自 MCP-Universe 的 74 项复杂执行任务。 为了在真实的部署条件下严格评估网关能力，我们进一步构建了一个全面的真实世界工具池，其中包含来自 251 个真实 MCP 服务器的 11,118 个独特工具。 图 3 提供了该基准测试数据集的高层次概览。

paragraphs.en: To comprehensively evaluate agent performance across diverse real-world workflows and adversarial scenarios, we construct our task dataset from two complementary benchmarks: the DecodingTrust-Agent Platform ( DTap ) ( Chen et al., 2026 ) and MCP-Universe ( Luo et al., 2025 ) . DTap provides a rigorous testbed for agent robustness, featuring both benign workflows and malicious scenarios equipped with adversary tools, while MCP-Universe grounds agent interactions in authentic, long-horizon environments using real-world MCP servers.
paragraphs.zh: 为了全面评估智能体在多样化真实工作流程和对抗性场景中的表现，我们从两个互补的基准测试中构建任务数据集：DecodingTrust-Agent 平台（DTap）（Chen 等人，2026）和 MCP-Universe（Luo 等人，2025）。 DTap 为智能体的鲁棒性提供了一个严格的测试环境，既包含良性工作流程，也配备了带有对抗工具的恶意场景；而 MCP-Universe 则通过真实世界的 MCP 服务器，将智能体的互动置于真实且长期运行的环境中。

paragraphs.en: Since our experimental design systematically varies both the MCP gateway architectures and the scale of injected noisy tools, evaluating the entirety of these original datasets would incur excessive token consumption. Therefore, we select a subset of each dataset to construct a highly representative yet computationally tractable task subset.

paragraphs.en: The DecodingTrust-Agent Platform ( DTap ) is a controllable and interactive red-teaming platform spanning 14 real-world domains, designed to evaluate the security and resilience of LLM agents. To capture a broad spectrum of enterprise and consumer applications, we select three representative domains: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) , Finance , and Travel . For each domain, we uniformly sample the original dataset at fixed intervals to construct a balanced subset. Specifically, we extract 50 benign tasks, 50 direct attack tasks, and 50 indirect attack tasks per domain. This yields a comprehensive collection of 450 tasks, enabling us to systematically quantify how varying tool-set scales and gateway architectures influence an agent’s resilience against adversarial manipulation.
paragraphs.zh: DecodingTrust-Agent 平台（DTap）是一个可控且可交互的“红队测试”平台，覆盖 14 个真实世界领域，旨在评估大型语言模型智能体的安全性与弹性。 为了涵盖广泛的企业和消费者应用场景，我们选择了三个具有代表性的领域：客户关系管理（CRM）、金融和旅行。 对于每个领域，我们以固定间隔均匀采样原始数据集，以构建一个均衡的子集。 具体而言，我们从每个领域中提取 50 个良性任务、50 个直接攻击任务和 50 个间接攻击任务。 由此我们获得了包含 450 个任务的全面集合，能够系统性地量化不同工具集规模和网关架构如何影响智能体对抗恶意操控的弹性。

paragraphs.en: To further assess gateway performance in authentic execution environments, we incorporate tasks from MCP-Universe, which focuses on benign tasks grounded in real-world MCP servers and live environments. We select three complex, multi-step domains: Repository Management , Browser Automation , and Location Navigation . To ensure that the benchmark effectively discriminates between different gateway architectures, we manually review and remove tasks that are either trivially solvable or too hard for tested agents, resulting in a refined set of 74 high-quality tasks that provide a meaningful signal for distinguishing gateway designs.
paragraphs.zh: 为了进一步评估网关在真实执行环境中的性能，我们纳入了来自 MCP-Universe 的任务。该数据集专注于基于真实世界 MCP 服务器和实际运行环境的良性任务。 我们选择了三个复杂的多步骤领域：仓库管理、浏览器自动化和位置导航。 为确保基准测试能有效区分不同架构的网关，我们对任务进行了人工审查并移除了那些要么过于简单、要么对受测智能体而言难度过高的任务。最终，我们得到了一个包含 74 个高质量任务的优化集合，这些任务能够有效地反映不同网关设计的差异。

paragraphs.en: For evaluation, we directly adopt the rule-based evaluation frameworks native to both DTap and MCP-Universe. DTap provides verifiable judge that inspect the final environment state, with dedicated success criteria for both benign task completion and attack objectives. MCP-Universe similarly provides execution-based evaluators that perform domain-specific validation such as verifying branch existence in repository management. These rule-based judges ensure consistent, reproducible, and objective assessment across all our experiments.

paragraphs.en: A defining feature of GatewayBench is its large-scale, carefully curated pool of noisy tools that can be dynamically injected into the agent’s tool list. This design allows us to rigorously stress-test the gateway’s capabilities under realistic MCP deployment scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: GatewayBench 的一个显著特点是其大规模、精心挑选的噪声工具库，这些工具可以动态注入到智能体的工具列表中。 这种设计使我们能够在真实的 MCP 部署场景下，严格测试网关的功能表现。

paragraphs.en: For each tool, we retain its full interface specification that the original server exposes according to the MCP specification: a natural-language description summarizing the tool’s purpose, a JSON Schema defining the expected parameters and types, and per-parameter descriptions documenting the semantics of each input field. This metadata faithfully mirrors what a real MCP server presents to an agent, ensuring that the noisy tools are indistinguishable from a real-world deployment. In total, we collect 251 MCP servers comprising 11,118 tools , forming a diverse and realistic noisy tool pool.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个工具，我们都保留其原始服务器根据 MCP 规范所暴露的完整接口规范：一份用自然语言撰写的摘要，说明该工具的功能；一个定义预期参数和类型的 JSON Schema；以及每个参数的描述，记录各个输入字段的语义。 这些元数据忠实地再现了真实 MCP 服务器向智能体呈现的内容，从而确保这些含噪声的工具与真实部署环境中的工具无法区分。 我们总共收集了 251 个 MCP 服务器，包含 11,118 个工具，构成了一个多样化且逼真的含噪声工具池。

paragraphs.en: To safely integrate these tools without triggering unintended real-world side effects or authentication requirements, we implement a generic mock MCP server that registers the authentic tool schemas and descriptions to the gateway but provides no actual implementation. Whenever the agent invokes any tool, the server returns a standard error response rather than executing any real operation. This design effectively isolates the stochasticity and complexities of the real world.
paragraphs.zh: 为了安全地集成这些工具，同时避免触发非预期的现实世界副作用或身份验证要求，我们实现了一个通用的模拟 MCP 服务器。该服务器向网关注册真实的工具模式和描述，但不提供任何实际实现。 每当智能体调用任何工具时，服务器都会返回一个标准错误响应，而不是执行任何实际操作。 这种设计有效地隔离了现实世界的随机性和复杂性。

sents.en: To safely integrate these tools without triggering unintended real-world side effects or authentication requirements, we implement a generic mock MCP server that registers the authentic tool schemas and descriptions to the gateway but provides no actual implementation.

paragraphs.en: If a noisy tool overlaps with a task-relevant domain, the agent may legitimately attempt to invoke it. Such a call would then fail due to our mock implementation and deviate from the behavior of a genuine, fully functional server in real-world, thereby introducing an artificial source of task failure that affects the measurement of gateway-induced tool selection effects. Valid noisy tools must therefore be semantically orthogonal to the task.
paragraphs.zh: 如果一个存在噪声的工具与任务相关领域重叠，智能体可能会合理地尝试调用它。 由于我们的模拟实现，这样的调用将会失败，并偏离真实世界中完整功能服务器的行为，从而引入一个人为的任务失败原因，影响对网关引发的工具选择效应的测量。 因此，有效的噪声工具必须在语义上与任务正交。

paragraphs.en: We design an automated domain-aware filtering pipeline to enforce strict task irrelevance of noisy tools. For each task domain, we first prompt an LLM to summarize each of the domains along three axes: the general task goal, typical task patterns and workflows, and the MCP servers or tool categories semantically related to the domain. We then compare each noisy server’s tool descriptions against the summarized domain profile and only keep those servers that exhibit no semantic overlap with that specific domain, as determined by the LLM. This per-domain filtering guarantees that any noisy tool the agent encounters within a given domain is irrelevant. Additionally, during evaluation, for a given experimental setting specifying N N noisy tools, we deterministically sample a fixed subset from the filtered noisy tool pool. This choice is helpful for maintaining KV cache friendliness and experimental stability across different gateway and LLM evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们设计了一条自动化的领域感知过滤流程，以确保噪声工具与任务严格无关。 对于每个任务领域，我们首先提示一个大语言模型（LLM），从三个维度对每个领域进行总结：一般任务目标、典型的任务模式与工作流程，以及与该领域在语义上相关的 MCP 服务器或工具类别。 接着，我们将每个噪声服务器的工具描述与总结好的领域特征进行比较，仅保留那些经 LLM 判定与该特定领域不存在语义重叠的服务器。 这种按领域进行的过滤确保了智能体在给定领域内遇到的任何噪声工具都与任务无关。 此外，在评估过程中，对于指定了 N 个噪声工具的实验设置，我们会从过滤后的噪声工具池中确定性地采样一个固定的子集。 这一选择在维持 KV 缓存友好性以及跨不同网关和 LLM 评估的实验稳定性方面十分有效。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate seven MCP gateways with diverse agent and tool configurations on GatewayBench . We find that (1) the underlying model and agent harness jointly affect how well a gateway performs, (2) different gateways show asymmetric sensitivity to tool-set scaling, (3) on adversarial tasks, hierarchical gateways are markedly more robust to indirect tool-injection attacks, and (4) flattened gateways are faster and cheaper on small tool sets but suffer from linear growth in task time and token consumption as more noisy tools are injected.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 GatewayBench 上评估了七种具有不同智能体和工具配置 MCP 网关。 我们发现：（1）底层模型与智能体机制共同影响网关的性能；（2）不同网关对工具集扩展的敏感度存在差异；（3）在对抗性任务中，分层网关对间接工具注入攻击的鲁棒性显著更强；（4）扁平化网关在小规模工具集上运行更快且成本更低，但随着更多噪声工具的注入，其任务执行时间和令牌消耗会呈线性增长。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate every gateway under a few representative agent configurations, varying the underlying model and the agent harness. For the model, we use GPT-5.1 and GPT-5.4, spanning two tiers of capability, to study how model capability affects agent performance and robustness across gateways. For the agent harness, we use two widely adopted implementations, the OpenAI Agents SDK ( OpenAI, 2025 ) and OpenClaw ( OpenClaw, 2026 ) , to study how the harness affects the same outcomes. We take the OpenAI Agents SDK with GPT-5.1 as the base configuration and alter one factor at a time, which gives three agent configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在几种代表性的智能体配置下评估每个网关，其中底层模型和智能体框架各不相同。 在模型方面，我们使用了 GPT-5.1 和 GPT-5.4，这两个模型代表了两个不同能力层级，旨在研究模型能力如何影响智能体在不同网关中的性能和稳健性。 在智能体框架方面，我们采用了两种广泛使用的实现方式：OpenAI Agents SDK（OpenAI, 2025）和 OpenClaw（OpenClaw, 2026），以研究框架如何影响上述结果。 我们将 OpenAI Agents SDK 与 GPT-5.1 的组合作为基础配置，并每次仅改变一个因素，由此得到三种智能体配置。

paragraphs.en: We mainly report two families of metrics: task success rate (TSR), the fraction of benign tasks the agent completes correctly, and attack success rate (ASR), the fraction of adversarial tasks on which the injected malicious goal is achieved. Attacks differ by how the malicious instruction reaches the agent: direct injection through the user prompt (ASR d ), and indirect injection through the tool surface (ASR ind ), which we split into tool injection (ASR tool {}_{\text{tool}} ) and environment injection (ASR env {}_{\text{env}} ). We also report TSR ind , the task success rate under indirect attack.
paragraphs.zh: 我们主要报告两类指标：任务成功率（TSR），即智能体正确完成的良性任务比例；以及攻击成功率（ASR），即注入的恶意目标在对抗性任务中实现的比例。 攻击方式取决于恶意指令如何到达智能体：通过用户提示直接注入（ASR d），以及通过工具接口间接注入（ASR ind），后者我们进一步分为工具注入（ASR tool {}_{\text{tool}}）和环境注入（ASR env {}_{\text{env}}）。 我们还报告了 TSR ind，即间接攻击下的任务成功率。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 reports the capability and security of all seven gateways with no noisy tools injected. Hierarchical gateways attain substantially lower indirect attack success than flattened ones under every agent configuration (mean ASR ind of 19.6 % 19.6\% vs. 60.5 % 60.5\% , 30.9 % 30.9\% vs. 47.2 % 47.2\% , and 15.6 % 15.6\% vs. 42.5 % 42.5\% ), but they can trade away some benign task success to get it. paragraphs.en: A gateway shapes the tool surface, not the user prompt, so it should not govern direct injection: under the capability-matched GPT-5.4, the two architecture types are indistinguishable on it ( 44.7 % 44.7\% vs. 44.2 % 44.2\% ). Indirect injection is where the gateway matters, and Figure 4 decomposes it into environment and tool injection under OpenClaw with GPT-5.1; the other two agent configurations show a similar pattern (Appendix A.2 ). Tool injection separates the two architecture types at every noisy-tool count: the flattened architecture’s mean runs from 51.5 % 51.5\% down to 40.6 % 40.6\% as noisy tools accumulate, whereas the hierarchical architecture stays near 16 % 16\% throughout, and the per-gateway spread within each type never closes this gap. Environment injection shows no such separation: the ASR means of the two architectures track each other closely, with overlapping per-gateway ranges. This is what the architecture predicts, since a gateway governs which tools enter the agent’s context but not what an environment returns. By exposing tools through discovery meta-tools, hierarchical gateways give an injected tool’s malicious content fewer chances to reach the agent’s context, which translates into better security in practice.
paragraphs.zh: 网关塑造的是工具表面，而非用户提示，因此它不应控制直接注入：在能力匹配的 GPT-5.4 下，这两种架构类型在此方面无法区分（44.7% 44.7\% 对比 44.2% 44.2\%）。 间接注入是网关发挥作用的地方，图 4 将其分解为 OpenClaw 中使用 GPT-5.1 时的环境与工具注入；另外两种智能体配置也呈现出相似的模式（附录 A.2）。 在任意数量的噪声工具下，工具注入都能区分这两种架构类型：随着噪声工具的累积，扁平化架构的平均值从 51.5% 51.5\% 下降至 40.6% 40.6\%，而分层架构则始终保持在 16% 16\% 附近，且每种类型内部各网关的分布差异从未缩小这一差距。 环境注入并未表现出这种分离：两种架构的 ASR 平均值彼此紧密跟随，且各网关的取值范围相互重叠。 这正是该架构所预测的结果，因为网关控制的是哪些工具进入智能体的上下文，而非环境返回的内容。 通过发现元工具暴露工具，分层网关能减少注入工具的恶意内容到达智能体上下文的机会，从而在实践中带来更好的安全性。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 reports the two components of interaction cost. The two architecture types diverge far more sharply in token cost: under GPT-5.4 the flattened architecture’s mean climbs from 8.3 8.3 k to 233.3 233.3 k tokens per turn, whereas the hierarchical architecture remains stable, from 9.1 9.1 k to 12.6 12.6 k. The gap is mechanical: a flattened gateway keeps the entire tool list in the agent’s context throughout the task, so every turn’s prompt carries all tool schemas, whereas a hierarchical one keeps all but the retrieved tools out of context. The latency comparison of two types of gateway depends on the number of tools. With no noisy tools, flattened gateway is in fact faster ( 20.8 20.8 s against 30.1 30.1 s), since discovery costs extra turns. But the advantage reverses between 500 500 and 1,000 1{,}000 tools, and by 1,500 1{,}500 flattened gateway needs 64.1 64.1 s against 38.7 38.7 s. What flattened gateway saves in turns on a small tool set it more than repays in context once the tool set is large. Appendix A.3 reports the GPT-5.1 curves and per-tool-call latency.

paragraphs.en: We introduced GatewayBench , the first systematic benchmark for evaluating MCP gateways across capability, efficiency, and adversarial robustness. Through extensive experiments spanning diverse gateway implementations, agent configurations, and noisy tool scales, we underscore that the MCP gateway plays a critical role in determining an agent system’s overall performance and security. As a core component of the agent harness, the gateway should be designed and evaluated together with other harness components. Overall, GatewayBench provides a rigorous testbed for evaluating MCP gateway designs and contributes to building more capable, efficient, and secure agentic systems.

paragraphs.en: Tool-call latency exposes a difference that the aggregate task time hides. For flattened gateways the average tool call is cheap and roughly constant (about 0.6 0.6 s) irrespective of the number of injected noisy tools, since the gateway simply forwards the call to the upstream server. Hierarchical gateways split sharply: strata and bifrost are even faster per call (around 0.2 0.2 s and 0.1 0.1 s), whereas enkrypt is far slower and grows with the pool (from 2.6 2.6 s to 5.4 5.4 s under GPT-5.4), because its layered discovery meta-tools return large server-and-tool listings on every call (Section 3 ). Enkrypt therefore trades many cheap turns for a few expensive discovery calls, which accounts for much of its elevated task time.

paragraphs.en: Among the flattened gateways evaluated in this work, AgentCore is unique in providing a built-in search tool that semantically matches tools to the agent’s intent. To examine whether this additional search tool offers any practical benefit, we count the number of task runs in which the agent actually invoked the search tool. As shown in Table 5 , in 1,800 runs per agent setting, search tool usage is negligible. We speculate that the agent directly locates the tools relevant to the task and proceeds without invoking search, since all necessary tools are already visible. Besides, LLM agents are trained to minimize unnecessary tool calls. These results suggest that a search tool provides limited utility when the full tool list is already exposed.
paragraphs.zh: 在本研究中评估的所有扁平化网关中，AgentCore 的独特之处在于它提供了一个内置的搜索工具，能够根据语义将工具与智能体的意图进行匹配。 为了检验这一额外的搜索工具是否带来任何实际益处，我们统计了智能体真正调用该搜索工具的任务运行次数。 如表 5 所示，在每种智能体设置下进行的 1,800 次运行中，搜索工具的使用可以忽略不计。 我们推测，由于所有必要工具均已可见，智能体会直接定位与任务相关的工具，而无需调用搜索功能即可继续执行。 此外，大型语言模型智能体经过训练，能够尽量减少不必要的工具调用。 这些结果表明，当完整的工具列表已经全部呈现时，搜索工具的实用价值有限。

sents.en: To examine whether this additional search tool offers any practical benefit, we count the number of task runs in which the agent actually invoked the search tool.
sents.zh: 为了检验这一额外的搜索工具是否带来任何实际益处，我们统计了智能体真正调用该搜索工具的任务运行次数。

sents.en: As shown in Table 5 , in 1,800 runs per agent setting, search tool usage is negligible.
sents.zh: 如表 5 所示，在每种智能体设置下进行的 1,800 次运行中，搜索工具的使用可以忽略不计。

sents.en: We speculate that the agent directly locates the tools relevant to the task and proceeds without invoking search, since all necessary tools are already visible.
sents.zh: 我们推测，由于所有必要工具均已可见，智能体会直接定位与任务相关的工具，而无需调用搜索功能即可继续执行。

sents.en: Besides, LLM agents are trained to minimize unnecessary tool calls.
sents.zh: 此外，大型语言模型智能体经过训练，能够尽量减少不必要的工具调用。

sents.en: These results suggest that a search tool provides limited utility when the full tool list is already exposed.
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，当完整的工具列表已经全部呈现时，搜索工具的实用价值有限。

paragraphs.en: Enkrypt adopts a hierarchical mechanism, which naturally yields good token efficiency. However, its actual implementation severely undermines this benefit. Specifically, Enkrypt returns tool definitions as JSON-encoded configuration blobs that include extensive metadata irrelevant to the agent, such as internal runtime commands, guardrail settings, and connection parameters. Furthermore, its default tool entrypoint attempts to return the full tool list at once but frequently fails due to timeouts when the available tool set is large. When the underlying model is weak, the agent often attempts to skip discovery steps and directly invokes tools with hallucinated names and parameters, which leads to poor task success rates.
paragraphs.zh: Enkrypt 采用了一种分层机制，这天然带来了良好的令牌效率。 然而，其实际实现严重削弱了这一优势。 具体来说，Enkrypt 以 JSON 编码的配置块形式返回工具定义，其中包含了大量与智能体无关的元数据，例如内部运行时命令、护栏设置和连接参数。 此外，其默认的工具入口点试图一次性返回完整的工具列表，但当可用工具集较大时，由于超时而频繁失败。 当底层模型能力较弱时，智能体通常会尝试跳过发现步骤，直接调用带有幻觉名称和参数的工具，这会导致任务成功率低下。

paragraphs.en: Bifrost provides 4 meta tools to the agent: executeToolCode , getToolDocs , listToolFiles , and readToolFile . These meta tools creates a virtual filesystem where each server is represented as a Python stub file(.pyi). To reduce the token cost, the detailed description of the parameters are truncated in the file and agent need to call getToolDocs to get the full details. For weak models like GPT-5.1, the generated code often mishandles special characters such as newline characters inside string literals, writing as a physical line break rather than the escaped sequence (e.g. split(’\n’) ). This produces incorrect Python code and is consequently rejected by the parser, making the gateway effectively unusable for those models. For indirect malicious tasks, the truncated tool description protects the agent from seeing the malicious message and thus lowers the ASR.
paragraphs.zh: Bifrost 为智能体提供了 4 个元工具：executeToolCode、getToolDocs、listToolFiles 和 readToolFile。 这些元工具创建了一个虚拟文件系统，其中每个服务器都表现为一个 Python 占位文件（.pyi）。 为了减少 token 消耗，文件中的参数详细描述被截断了，智能体需要调用 getToolDocs 来获取完整信息。 对于像 GPT-5.1 这样的弱模型，生成的代码常常错误处理字符串字面量中的特殊字符（例如换行符），将其写成实际的换行而非转义序列（例如 split(’\n’)）。 这会导致生成的 Python 代码不正确，进而被解析器拒绝，使得该网关对这些模型实际上无法使用。 对于间接的恶意任务，截断的工具描述可以防止智能体看到恶意信息，从而降低 ASR。

sents.en: For weak models like GPT-5.1, the generated code often mishandles special characters such as newline characters inside string literals, writing as a physical line break rather than the escaped sequence (e.g. split(’\n’) ).
sents.zh: 对于像 GPT-5.1 这样的弱模型，生成的代码常常错误处理字符串字面量中的特殊字符（例如换行符），将其写成实际的换行而非转义序列（例如 split(’\n’)）。

sents.en: This produces incorrect Python code and is consequently rejected by the parser, making the gateway effectively unusable for those models.
sents.zh: 这会导致生成的 Python 代码不正确，进而被解析器拒绝，使得该网关对这些模型实际上无法使用。

sents.en: For indirect malicious tasks, the truncated tool description protects the agent from seeing the malicious message and thus lowers the ASR.
sents.zh: 对于间接的恶意任务，截断的工具描述可以防止智能体看到恶意信息，从而降低 ASR。

paragraphs.en: Strata provides 5 meta tools to the agent: discover_server_actions , get_action_details , execute_action , search_documentation , and handle_auth_failure . The agent must first search the required tools using a semantic query and get the detail of the tool before invoking. However, when the model is not well trained for this situation like GPT-5.1, it often skips the discovery process and directly invokes hallucinated tools or parameters.
paragraphs.zh: Strata 为智能体提供了 5 种元工具：discover_server_actions、get_action_details、execute_action、search_documentation 和 handle_auth_failure。 智能体在调用工具之前，必须首先通过语义查询搜索所需工具，并获取该工具的详细信息。 然而，当模型（如 GPT-5.1）未针对这种情况进行良好训练时，它通常会跳过发现过程，直接调用虚构的工具或参数。
